vulkanmod.options.advCulling.tooltip: Use a culling algorithm that might improve performance by reducing the number of non visible chunk sections rendered.
vulkanmod.options.ao.subBlock.tooltip: Enables smooth lighting for non full block (experimental).
vulkanmod.options.entityCulling.tooltip: Enables frustum and section visibility culling for entities.
vulkanmod.options.blockEntityCulling.too: Frustum-culls individual block entities (chests, signs, banners, beacons) to reduce CPU and draw overhead.
vulkanmod.options.frameQueue.tooltip: Higher values might help stabilize frametime but will increase input lag.
vulkanmod.options.backfaceCulling.toolti: Culls not visible block faces on the CPU improving GPU performance. To prevent increased CPU overhead enable Indirect Draw.
vulkanmod.options.indirectDraw.tooltip: Reduces CPU overhead but might increase GPU overhead.
vulkanmod.options.uniqueOpaqueLayer.tool: Use a unique render layer for opaque terrain to improve performance.
vulkanmod.options.wayland.tooltip: Use Linux Wayland compositor if available (Experimental). Requires restart.
vulkanmod.options.asyncChunkUploads.tool: Synchronizes chunk uploads on the GPU with semaphores instead of stalling the CPU at frame end. Greatly improves frame pacing when loading chunks.
vulkanmod.options.chunkUploadBudget.tool: Limits background chunk upload time per frame to prevent micro-stutters during world streaming. Player block edits always upload immediately.
vulkanmod.options.fastTerrainSampling.to: Uses a crisp nearest-neighbor mipmapped sampler and skips vanilla analytic pixel-edge AA shader math for extra GPU FPS. Off by default for 100% vanilla visuals.
vulkanmod.options.animateOnlyVisibleText: Only ticks and uploads animated block textures that are present in visible chunk sections, reducing CPU and GPU transfer overhead.
vulkanmod.options.hudMode.tooltip: Displays a lightweight corner overlay with FPS, VRAM usage, and visible chunk count without opening F3.
vulkanmod.options.persistentPipelineCach: Saves compiled Vulkan graphics pipelines to disk to reduce shader hitching on subsequent launches.
